title: Nordic Spirit Icy Peppermint Nicotine Pouches
description: Nordic Spirit Icy Peppermint Extra Strong Nicotine Pouches deliver a brisk and refreshing mint profile with an intensely cool finish. Designed for users who prefer a robust and immediate sensation, this flavour provides a sharp, clean peppermint burst that is both deeply cooling and satisfying. Unlike standard dry pouches, Icy Peppermint features a moist formulation. This allows for a more rapid release of both flavour and nicotine, ensuring a fast-acting experience from the moment the pouch is placed under the lip. Each pouch is slim, discreet, and made from soft plant-based fibres for maximum comfort. With an Extra Strong 11mg nicotine content, these pouches deliver a steady, reliable release without any smoke, vapour, or odour, making them a highly practical and portable alternative for experienced users. How to Use: Place one Nordic Spirit pouch under your upper lip and allow the nicotine to release over time for a steady, satisfying experience. The pouch is designed to dissolve slowly for up to 40 minutes, providing an effective nicotine release without smoke or odour. Dispose of the pouch responsibly after use. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
